# Keep unsaved profile edits through browser history

## What & Why
The current history regression covers answer and opportunity recovery notices, but not an in-progress profile form. Visiting another workspace view and returning should not silently discard profile edits.

## Done looks like
- Unsaved profile fields remain intact after profile → answers → profile history traversal
- Back and forward navigation preserves the same in-progress profile values
- The coverage uses the existing persistence browser test patterns
